review: Reviewed Moss's round-22 request (weave-grass-mat: make a small portable sitting mat by physically working suitable gathered dry grass, if that material can support it; a dry grass source seen at (14.2, 16.3), nothing gathered or tested, costs unknown, durability and any comfort only under an explicit physical contract and trial, no guaranteed belonging or responses) and the World Agent's develop review (learning 3): a general hand-weave-fiber-mat(target, materials, mode, position) operation for any learner and suitable fibrous plant material with modes test, assemble/resume, inspect, trial, repair, place, dismantle and cancel, producing one unbacked hand-plaited 0.45 x 0.45 m portable sitting mat from exactly 4 gathered units after a 0.1-unit material test, with a 0.5-energy layout, six 1-energy paid rounds ending in a lift-and-integrity check, wear of 0.0005 per exposed round and 0.002 per occupied round, a +0.5 physical-comfort contribution only while sitting on a dry intact mat that passed a trial, and no thermal, rain, wind, medical, nutrition or automatic response effect. The specification is self-consistent and every part except the comfort term and moisture has an honest basis in the world, so this is a simplified real mechanism, not a first release. Implemented hand-weave-fiber-mat@1 in scope long-ex16 (learning 3; the ability serializes to 3,461 code units, within the 3,500 limit) in packages/world-core/src/long-fiber-mat.ts. Test (sample: an owned unreserved stack of at least 0.1; 1 round, 0.5 energy, the probe trial cost) splits exactly 0.1 off into an owned, identified tested-scrap stack of the same resource, origin and age, so nothing disappears, and reports the probe-revealed flexibility and strength, brittleness, sample condition, whether strips form and whether a tucked edge is retained; it passes only for untreated thin grass-like stems (dry grass, reeds) with flexibility at least 0.4 and an intact sample (condition at least 0.5); roots, branches, moss and other materials fail with the measured reason; the result is stored per resource and source with the sample id and tick (a retest replaces it) as a verified personal record (fiber-mat-tested; its information-confirmed event carries this interface, so the probe-bound grounded-understanding rule does not apply). Assemble (x, y and materials: exactly 4.0 owned units, in 0.1 steps, of one stem fiber whose resource and source a passing test by the same person covers; fresh units, earlier offcuts, recovered fiber or scraps of that source may be combined) requires mastery, a clear 0.45 m square in reach (inside the world, not over water, overlapping no plant, object, site or entrance and no other living person) and 0.5 energy; it reserves the units through collective-work escrow with exact source provenance (still carried, owned and counted as load; fiber-mat-started), creates the workpiece object and pays the layout round (0.5 energy), which sums the actual intact fiber mass (quantity x resource mass x intact share) against the declared requirement: a shortfall stops the work, returns every reserved tenth once and makes no mat (fiber-mat-shortfall, with the measured shortfall); otherwise six paid rounds of 1 energy follow (two strip-forming rounds that move 2 and then the remaining 2 units from escrow into the workpiece with identity, origin and age, two interlacing rounds, one edge-tucking round and the lift check; fiber-mat-layout and fiber-mat-progress record each round once), continuing each round, 6.5 energy in all. The lift check keeps exactly the needed tenths, most intact first (3.7 units of dry grass, 0.37 mass), returns the rest to the weaver as owned offcuts (intact share at least 0.5) or scraps, so input = fiber in the mat + offcuts + scraps, and passes only with full fiber and condition at least 0.5, i.e. a largest opening of 0.06 x (1 - condition) m of at most 0.03 m (fiber-mat-completed); otherwise the mat stays failed and unusable (fiber-mat-check-failed). An unworked round, too little energy, leaving reach or another person on the square pause before any charge (fiber-mat-paused); assemble or repair naming the mat resumes after the rechecks at the recorded unpaid round (fiber-mat-resumed); lost reserved fiber stops the work (fiber-mat-failed). Cancel (no energy) returns unincorporated fiber once and leaves incorporated fiber as a loose workpiece at the square, which cannot be lifted or sat on and can be dismantled (fiber-mat-cancelled); death stops the work and drops reserved fiber where the person died, and a carried mat is laid down there as the same mat. Inspect (anyone who studied, target in reach; 1 round, 0.2 energy) records status, stage, the declared 0.45 x 0.45 m size, fiber quantity and mass, condition, broken and missing tenths, largest opening, loose ends, moisture as not represented, current rain, position, holder, occupants and passing trials without repairing anything (fiber-mat-inspected, unverified record). Trial (anyone who studied; standing on a complete lying mat on ground that is not water or wet bank, with waterlogging at most 0.1, no hazard, no rain falling on it and nobody else on it; 1 round, 0.2 energy) records weave retention, slipping, breakage, skin contact and flattening (not represented) and lists the person among passing trials (fiber-mat-trial). Maker-only modes: repair (the mat inspected by the person since its last check; materials: exactly 1 unit of the mat's fiber covered by a test; 3 paid rounds of 1 energy) removes up to 1 unit of broken stems as owned scrap, interlaces the same amount plus any missing fiber (at most 1 unit) from the reserved unit, reruns the lift check and returns the unused surplus, so the condition rises only to the actual intact share (fiber-mat-repaired, then completed or check-failed); lift (1 round, 0.2 energy; a finished mat with nobody on it) turns the mat's fiber into reserved stacks owned by the carrier, so it counts as load and cannot be dropped, given, eaten, probed or tested piecemeal, and the object follows the carrier (fiber-mat-lifted); place (1 round, 0.2 energy; the carried mat and a square checked as for assembly) lays the same mat down, never blocking movement (fiber-mat-placed); dismantle (1 round, 0.5 energy) returns each lot's intact share as owned recovered fiber and the rest as scraps and removes the mat (fiber-mat-dismantled). Every round each lot in a mat or workpiece loses 0.0005 of intact share, or 0.002 while a living person's position is on the lying mat; a complete mat below 0.5 becomes needs-repair and clears its passing trials (fiber-mat-damaged) and cannot be sat on until repaired and tried again. No energy, time or broken stems are refunded or restored. The completion event carries no qualified flag, so no practice milestone is awarded, and no satisfaction, comfort or reward source is added; the experience review's optional short-pleasure and 0.2 sustained recognition were left out because the specification does not require them. Comfort: physical wellbeing (continuous-wellbeing.ts, v7Wellbeing) is recomputed every round as physicalCap x (0.3 x health/100 + 0.25 x satiety/100 + 0.25 x energy/energyCap + 0.2 x thermal comfort from body temperature) with no term for contact or cushioning, and the kernel rejects any action handler or environment response that writes wellbeing; the only inputs a package can reach are the vitals, and routing +0.5 through energy or body temperature would invent recovery or insulation that the specification excludes, so no honest path exists and the +0.5 contribution is omitted (trials record comfort 0); a cushioning term would need a separately reviewed change to the wellbeing rule. Wetness: food-water.ts initializes only food (nutrition above 0) and rejects grass, and the existing material moisture value (fuelMoisture) is updated only under the local-fire representation, which ex16 does not enable, so fiber and mat moisture are not represented; the trial instead requires no current rain at the mat and firm ground, a mat that lay in rain is not modeled as wet afterwards, and no drying command exists. Unit mapping: one specification unit is one world unit of the fiber resource (dry grass: 0.1 mass per unit, obtained with the unchanged base gather at one round and 2 energy per unit from the finite source stock in interaction range); no source fact is exposed or pre-committed. Modeling assumptions: the world gives grass no stem length, diameter or count, so dimensions are declared and yield is mass-based: mass units are read as kilograms and a plaited thin-stem layer is taken to weigh 0.6 per m2, so two crossing layers over 0.45 x 0.45 m with x1.5 for overlapping ends and edges tucked back about 0.05 m per side need 0.3645 mass (3.7 dry-grass units, 1.5 reed units); the 4-unit recipe is therefore an allocation with a measured margin, and a shortfall arises only when part of the 4 units is broken fiber (tested scraps or worn recovered fiber); thin stem form is declared only for dry grass and reeds; the 0.4 flexibility threshold is twice ex16 branch-screen@1's open-weave value and below ex15 simple-shelter@1's 0.7 for wrapped binding because plaited crossings bend thin strips over about one strip width; there is no friction or tensile model, so tuck retention follows from flexibility and an intact sample; condition is the intact share of stems, and the largest opening 0.06 x (1 - condition) m ties the specification's 0.03 m limit to the ex15 sound condition 0.5; people have no body mass or posture, so a trial's load is one undifferentiated person, any living person whose position lies on the mat counts as occupying it, and slipping is excluded by the firm-ground precondition rather than computed; hands are not represented and are not checked; dry grass and reeds have decay rate 0, so holding fiber inside a mat changes no ageing; the mat is non-solid; only the maker may repair, lift, place or dismantle, and handing a mat to another person is not supported in this version. Grounded: real dry-grass units, escrow, mass, provenance and conservation in tenths, energy and round costs, ground conditions, probe-revealed material values, current rain and the existing carried-load rule. Not grounded (declared or approximated): stem geometry, the areal mass and allowance, the thin-stem list, the flexibility threshold, the opening relation, the absence of friction, posture and body mass, and the wear rates (taken from the specification). Reuse: collective-work.ts escrow, paid work and stop; material-lots.ts portions; open-physical.ts ground conditions and openMaterial values; open-foundation.ts openRemember; forest-climate.ts rain; the ex15 waterlogging limit from long-shelter-exposure.ts; the staged paid-work, pause, resume, cancel, death, inspect, repair and dismantle pattern of ex16 branch-screen@1 and ex15 simple-shelter@1, re-implemented here with earlier packages unchanged (ex7-ex15 replay compatibility identical); the unchanged base gather; the probe handler itself is not called because it deletes its sample, while the specification requires the sample to remain as identified scrap. New file long-fiber-mat.ts, registered in continuous.ts, and a small fiber-mat drawing in continuous-visuals.ts (dashed square with loose strands until strips are laid, strips and crossings only as paid rounds lay them, grey with broken ends when loose, failed or worn, a roll while carried; no comfort is drawn). Tests cover scope, learning, the size limit, excluded vocabulary, the test cost and scrap, an informative root failure, cost-free refusals, the seven rounds and 6.5 energy, conservation, load, the drawing, a measured shortfall, pause and resume, cancel before and after the strip rounds, inspection and a sitting trial by another person with the wellbeing formula unchanged, wear rates and damage, exact repair, lift and place, dismantling and death.
